title: Card title: the Improvements board (where people file issues and requests), as seen from Reliability.
description: "File issue" is a button's name in Runs; "Runs" is the page listing turns.
chart: Accessible name of the menu that picks what the board's chart shows.
reported: Tile and menu choice: items filed on the board.
resolved: Tile and menu choice: items closed as done on the board.
axis.reported: What the chart's values are, in a sentence for screen readers. Lowercase.
bugs: Of the items reported, how many were bugs.
median: The tile's value is the median.
within: 90% of items took at most {{span}} (a span such as 3 h or 2.5 days).
open-note: The Open tile counts items still open when the range ends.
report-time: Tile: how long after a turn failed someone filed an issue about it.
filed-count: How many failed turns were filed as issues from the Runs page.
